name: FR
context: France electricity market dataset with hourly electricity price and exogenous load and generation measurements spanning 6 years (2012-01-09 to 2017-12-31).

endo.name: price
endo.description: Day-ahead hourly electricity price in the French electricity market (EUR/MWh).

exo.name: load_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted total electricity load in MW for France, reflecting anticipated national electricity demand.

exo.name: generation_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted total power generation in MW for France, capturing expected domestic supply conditions that influence electricity prices.
